instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: You go to buy your usual coffee, but then you stop. Hey, when did you become so fancy? Tariffs are the first thing you think of. You want to say, so you're to blame. But a good detective stops and thinks first. Let's turn back the clock and examine this case. Reports based on government figures say the average U.S. price of ground coffee rose 41 percent. That was compared with the same month a year earlier. This is about ground coffee, not a cup in a café. Before coffee wakes you up, its price shocks your wallet awake. But Reuters says most of the rise in store prices came from bean shortages and higher bean prices. Those shortages began before the summer tariffs. Wait a minute, our case began before the suspect we watched even appeared.
